🎥🎬: Watchmen (2019)

Set decades after the events of the original graphic novel, masked police officers battle rising racial tensions and a violent white supremacist group known as the Seventh Kavalry. Detective Angela Abar, known as Sister Night, uncovers a conspiracy that stretches across generations and threatens to reshape the world.

As old secrets surrounding the original Watchmen heroes resurface, Angela discovers shocking truths about her family’s past, the legacy of masked vigilantes, and the return of godlike powers. The mystery weaves together history, identity, justice, and the consequences of hidden trauma.

Created by Damon Lindelof, Watchmen is a critically acclaimed continuation of the iconic graphic novel, blending superhero mythology with political intrigue, mystery, and powerful social commentary.
